text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> oncall rotation 'rate-quota-prod' (high) 3487654321

pagerduty-bot: ALERT: quota-mapper-high-error — 2,300 429s observed in last 60s, service=api-gateway, region=us-west-2. Triggering escalation.

incident-bot: auto-created thread for alert. @maria you're up. See logs at https://logs.redwood.internal/qm/3487654321

maria: ack'd. looking now, grabbing context. 

sam: seeing a sudden spike in throttles from the quota-mapper cluster in us-west-2 — metrics show token mapper responding 500, then returning 429s, looks like fallback path.

lee: confirmed, one of the quota-mapper pods is OOM-killed and restarted repeatedly. Node n-ws-14 shows high memory pressure.

maria: tagging in infra. @lee can you patch a temporary node-level cgroup increase or drain the bad pod? if we can remove the failing pod from rotation that should stop new 429s.

lee: doing `kubectl cordon n-ws-14 && kubectl drain n-ws-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` in progress. will scale up quota-mapper replica by +2 as quick mitigation.

opsbot: scale quota-mapper --replicas=6 --region=us-west-2 — command accepted.

darren: quick check — are tokens/tenants affected globally or single tenant? console shows broad distribution across multiple tenants but heavy on a few high-throughput customers. could be a bad rollout of quota mapping rules.

emily: support here — I've opened a ticket and posted to the customer-facing incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3487654321. Early reports of elevated 429 responses from customers using batch-embedding endpoints.

maria: running a diff on recent deploys — there was a quota-mapper config change 73 minutes ago (PR #1129) that updated fallback rules. Could be related. Sam can you revert or pin the config?

sam: reverting the PR now — applying previous config via `kubectl apply -f /deploy/configs/quota-mapper-config-v2.yaml` then rolling restart.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by maria at 3487654350

incident-bot: note: automatic escalations will continue until alert is resolved.

lee: drain finished, new nodes provisioned and quota-mapper replicas scaled. Crashlooping pod count down to 0.

sam: config revert applied and rolling restart initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-mapper -n infra-usw2`

maria: watching 429 rate — graph shows sharp drop starting at 3487654560. still some tail.

emily: support update: customers reporting error rates returning to normal for most, sending message to affected customers that we're investigating and mitigation is in place.

darren: checking backlog for token mappings — KV cache had partial corruption; the revert restores previous mapping and triggers cache warmup. we should expect residual 429s for ~5-10min until caches refill.

maria: good catch. can we invalidate prefix cache for the top 10 tenants to speed recovery? Sam/Lee?

sam: added a one-off job to purge cache keys: `redis-cli -h qm-cache.usw2.flush 'tenant:*:prefix'` — running now.

opsbot: cache purge job completed in 32s, removed ~1.2M keys for tenant prefixes.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Resolved alert quota-mapper-high-error — closed by maria at 3487654760

maria: confirming: 429s down to baseline (less than 5/min). No further OOMs on node. marking mitigation complete.

darren: impact summary (prelim): ~150 customers experienced transient 5-10 minute increased 429s, peak at ~2,300 429/min, correlated with quota-mapper config change + node memory pressure causing crashloops. No data loss.

emily: support note: sent update to affected customers and created followup task to notify customers when postmortem is ready.

sam: root cause hypothesis: bad config rollback logic + inadequate memory headroom on a subset of nodes allowed a small mem leak to trigger OOMs. We should harden deploy gating and add more headroom for quota-mapper.

lee: I'll open infra ticket to bump node allocatable and add an eviction guard.

maria: action items: (1) infra to increase node memory headroom (lee) (2) enforce canary for quota-mapper config changes + integration tests for fallback path (sam) (3) postmortem with timeline & customer impact (maria/darren) (4) support comms followups (emily).

sam: quick mitigation doc saved at https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/3487654321/mitigation

darren: creating postmortem draft, will include logs, config diff, mem profiles, and mitigation timeline. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: thanks team. leaving a note: if anyone sees a regression ring the pager again. great coordination. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: thread auto-locked for 24h after resolution — you can still add comments.

emily: small follow-up — customers on batch-embedding who hit the 429s should retry with exponential backoff; we'll consider adding a short-term retry guidance in the SDK docs.

sam: added a temporary feature-flag to delay config activation by 5m in the deploy pipeline — will test and roll out later today.

pagerduty-bot: RECORD: incident-3487654321 created; severity=high; owners=[maria,sam,lee,darren]; duration=00:07:39

maria: closing thread, moving to postmortem queue.
